evidence: `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:408-418` seeds all three stage timers from the legacy population timer, and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:510-520` applies one shared `failed_molt_accum` update across all resolved stages.

`crates/tank_core/tests/molt_mineral_budget.rs:371-395` is the new soft-vs-hard integration test; it uses direct `set_minerals(...)` calls and loops for 360 hours at `crates/tank_core/tests/molt_mineral_budget.rs:383-387`.

`crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs:281-295` defines `ca_min_mg_per_l`, `mg_min_mg_per_l`, `juvenile_molt_interval_days`, `sub_adult_molt_interval_days`, and `molt_success_threshold`, while `rg -n "ca_min_mg_per_l|mg_min_mg_per_l|juvenile_molt_interval_days|sub_adult_molt_interval_days|molt_success_threshold" crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs` returned no matches.
findings_or_gaps: High: `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:510-520` decreases `failed_molt_accum` whenever any stage succeeds, even if another stage fails on the same day. With the new per-stage cadence plus synchronized legacy seeding at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:408-418`, mixed outcome days are plausible; on those days a failed molt can incorrectly reduce later mortality pressure instead of increasing it.

Medium: The required long-horizon source-water integration coverage is still missing. `crates/tank_core/tests/molt_mineral_budget.rs:371-395` directly injects Ca/Mg and only runs 360 hours, so it does not satisfy the acceptance criterion for a 1000-hour RO-vs-`hard_shrimp` comparison tied to actual source-water profiles.

Medium: The newly introduced molt parameters are not validated on load/config boundaries. They are present in `crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs:281-295`, but `crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs:334-380` does not check them, so malformed values are silently coerced at runtime by `.max(0.01)` / `.max(1.0)` in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:356-367` and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:435-445` instead of being rejected.
follow_up_or_amendments: Change `molt_cycle` so a day with any failed molts cannot lower `failed_molt_accum`; either aggregate per-stage failure counts explicitly or only apply the recovery decrement on fully successful days.

Replace or extend the integration test with a 1000-hour comparison that starts from real `ro_like` and `hard_shrimp` source-water profiles and asserts both worse survival and observable molt-failure evidence in the mineral-poor case.

Add invariant/save-validation coverage for `ca_min_mg_per_l`, `mg_min_mg_per_l`, `juvenile_molt_interval_days`, `sub_adult_molt_interval_days`, and `molt_success_threshold`, plus tests proving malformed data is rejected.
